spec_family.name: Exterior Trim Repaint
spec_family.description: Condition-dependent repaint of existing exterior trim — all 8 component types (fascia, rake, frieze, corner, band, window casing, door casing, sill). Combined assess+prep+prime+finish in single mobilization. 4 substrate states drive primer selection and prep intensity. MPI Degree of Surface Degradation (DSD 0-4) is the secondary cost driver via FAC_TRRP_CONDITION prep multiplier — DSD-4 is a hard stop. Stacking partition separates prep modifiers (CONDITION, RRP) from coating modifiers (QT) to prevent compound blowout. Lead-safe RRP gate for pre-1978 buildings (trim is HIGH RISK for lead paint). Condition assessment mandatory before prep begins. Uses LF as primary UOM per PCA P10 one-foot rule (trim <12" wide = 1 SF per 1 LF). 3 substrate materials (wood, PVC, engineered_wood) drive primer selection as a modifier. Height and complexity modifiers are per-component — one building may have ground-level casings and extreme-height fascia. QT3-QT5 range (QT2 excluded — trim is fine-finish substrate). Brush is primary application method; spray is conditional on volume justifying masking overhead. Second repaint spec in the system after SF_SIDING_WOOD_EXT_RP.

includes: Condition assessment (DSD rating per component, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, moisture content, existing coating ID, rot probe)
Lead paint evaluation for pre-1978 buildings (EPA RRP compliance)
RRP containment setup and teardown when lead-positive
Low-pressure power wash all trim (500-1000 PSI, careful at joints)
Scraping loose/failing paint (DSD-driven intensity: light/moderate/heavy)
Feather-edge sanding ALL scraped areas (mandatory at all QT)
Chalk remediation (light or heavy per DSD) for SS_EXT_CHALKING
Light scuff sand for adhesion on SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT
PVC scuff sand (220-grit) before bonding primer
Engineered wood field-cut edge sealing
Caulk joint assessment and replacement per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol
Spot prime bare areas (sound paint, mild failing <30% bare)
Full prime coat (acrylic stain-block, alkyd stain-block/tannin, chalk-binding, bonding/PVC per state and material)
Second primer coat at QT5
Finish coat application — 2 coats all tiers (brush primary, spray conditional)
Interstage inspection, sand (QT4/QT5), and touch-up
Final walkthrough inspection and touch-up
Ground/landscape protection from scraping debris and paint drips
Hardscape/walkway protection
Window glass masking when painting adjacent casings
Door face masking when painting adjacent casings
Light fixture masking
Roofline edge protection (fascia/rake)
Siding masking (spray method only)
Equipment setup and cleanup (brush or spray)
Site debris cleanup (includes scraping debris collection)
Customer walkthrough

excludes.route_to: Carpentry/contractor — HARD_STOP (DSD-4) is outside painting scope
Future exterior stain spec — stain states excluded

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling coat count, inspection scrutiny, interstage sanding, and defect tolerance. Trim is fine-finish substrate — QT2 excluded.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT3=standard (satin, 2 finish coats, scan inspection). QT4=premium (semi-gloss, interstage sand between finish coats, systematic inspection). QT5=superior (gloss, 2-coat primer, interstage sand between ALL coats, raking light inspection, near-zero defect tolerance).

configuration_dimensions.description: Universal 3-level condition scale. Drives prep labor multiplier (FAC_TRRP_CONDITION). HARD_STOP = structural damage, outside painting scope.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Harmonized from DSD 0-4 to universal GOOD/FAIR/POOR scale. GOOD: sound paint, minimal prep (DSD 0-1). FAIR: moderate deterioration, targeted repair (DSD 2). POOR: severe deterioration, full remediation (DSD 3). HARD_STOP: substrate damage (DSD 4), refer to carpenter.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for prime and finish coats.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Brush is primary for trim (40 LF/hr baseline). Spray conditional on sufficient volume to justify masking overhead. brush_roll not applicable — trim is too narrow for roller.

configuration_dimensions.description: Trim substrate material. Drives primer selection and material-specific constraints. Modifier, not full workflow dimension.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Affects primer selection only. PVC triggers bonding primer + LRV >=55 or solar-reflective coating gate. Engineered_wood requires edge sealing. Per-component if mixed.

paintable_items.name: Exterior fascia board
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of fascia measured at eave/roofline. PCA P10 one-foot rule: <12" wide = 1 SF per 1 LF.
paintable_items.notes: Horizontal board at eave/roofline. Typically at high/extreme height tier. Highest rot-risk at rake junction.

paintable_items.name: Exterior rake board
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of rake trim following roofline at gable end.
paintable_items.notes: Diagonal trim spanning multiple height tiers from ground to peak.

paintable_items.name: Exterior frieze board
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of frieze board at top of wall below soffit.

paintable_items.name: Exterior corner board
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of corner boards at building corners, measured vertically.
paintable_items.notes: Vertical board spanning full wall height — may cross multiple height tiers.

paintable_items.name: Exterior band board
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of horizontal band/belt course between floors.
paintable_items.notes: Typically at first_8_13ft height tier on 2-story homes.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window casing
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of exterior window casing — sum of all sides of all windows in scope.
paintable_items.notes: Distinct from interior ITM_TRIM_CASING_WINDOW. _EXT suffix to avoid collision.

paintable_items.name: Exterior door casing
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of exterior door casing — sum of all sides of all doors in scope.
paintable_items.notes: Distinct from interior ITM_TRIM_CASING_DOOR. _EXT suffix to avoid collision.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window sill
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of exterior window sill measured at sill nose.
paintable_items.notes: Highest rot-risk component (horizontal surface collects water). _EXT suffix for exterior context.

variants.notes: BASELINE. Standard repaint on sound wood trim. Spot prime bare areas + 2 finish coats satin. Brush application. Minimal prep — wash, scuff sand, spot prime.
Standard repaint on sound paint with slight surface deterioration. DSD-1 prep multiplier (1.15x on prep tasks).
Standard repaint on failing paint with moderate deterioration. Moderate scraping + feather sand + spot prime bare areas. DSD-2 prep multiplier (1.375x).
PREMIUM. Sound trim with interstage sand between finish coats. Semi-gloss. QT4 modifier (1.25x on coating tasks).
Premium repaint on moderate failure. Full scrape + feather sand + full prime + interstage sand + 2 finish coats semi-gloss. DSD-2 + QT4 modifiers.
GALLERY. 2-coat spot primer on bare areas + interstage sand between ALL coats + 2 finish coats gloss. QT5 modifier (1.50x on coating tasks). Near-zero defect tolerance.
Standard repaint on chalking surface. Chalk remediation + chalk-binding primer (full coverage mandatory) + 2 finish coats satin.
Standard repaint on mild failing paint. Light scrape + feather sand + spot prime bare areas + 2 finish coats. DSD-1 prep multiplier.
Standard repaint on peeling surface, severe deterioration. Heavy scrape + feather sand + full prime + 2 finish coats. DSD-3 prep multiplier (1.75x). Most labor-intensive non-RRP variant.
PVC trim variant. Bonding primer on bare areas (standard acrylic will NOT adhere). LRV >=55 or solar-reflective coating gate for dark colors. 220-grit scuff sand before bonding primer.
Engineered wood trim variant. Edge sealing mandatory on field-cut edges (warranty requirement). Standard acrylic primer on bare areas.
Spray application variant. Adds siding masking zone. Full window/door masking. Justified only for full-house trim volume amortizing masking overhead.

RRP variant. Pre-1978 + lead-positive peeling trim. Adds RRP containment zone, wet scraping methods, HEPA vacuum, lead-safe disposal. RRP 2.0x modifier on all prep tasks involving paint disturbance. Most expensive common scenario.
Premium spray + RRP on moderate failure. Maximum protection zones (8). DSD-2 + RRP + QT4 modifiers. Represents near-worst-case common scenario.

protection_zones_required.notes: Landscape and ground surface protection. Scraping generates paint chips requiring containment at all application methods. Spray upgrades to full cover.
Walkways and patio surfaces below trim work areas. Drop cloth runners.
Window glass masking. Brush: tape at glass edge. Spray: full glass masking with paper/film.
Door face/glass masking. Brush: tape at junction. Spray: full door cover.
Exterior light fixtures on or adjacent to trim. Bag or tape over fixture.
Tape and paper at roofline edge to protect shingles and flashing from drips.
Mask siding adjacent to trim during spray application. Paper/film 12-24" from trim edge. Not needed for brush work.
EPA RRP Rule (40 CFR 745). 6-mil poly ground containment extending 10 ft from structure. Required when disturbing lead paint on pre-1978 structures.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Trim terminates at siding field. Typically different color (body vs trim). No wet-edge blending across specs. Protection-only relationship.
Soffit adjacent to fascia and frieze. Often same color as trim. Soffit is a separate spec.
Foundation below corner boards and band board. Not painted in this scope.
Window glass adjacent to window casing. Glass is protection target — mask when painting casings.
Door face adjacent to door casing. May be same or different color. Door painting is a separate spec.
Masonry wall adjacent to trim in brick/stone houses. Not painted in trim scope.

valid_input_states.notes: 4 repaint-specific exterior substrate states. SS_EXT_WEATHERED excluded — weathered trim with no coating is bare wood (enters via rot repair). SS_EXT_STAINED_* excluded — stained trim is a separate scope. SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD is NC spec domain.

output_state.notes: All repaint input states converge to painted output state. Sheen determined by quality tier: QT3=satin, QT4=semi-gloss, QT5=gloss.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: All tasks performed on the affected component (prep and coating). NOT applied to fixed-time tasks (assessment, equipment setup/cleanup, protection setup/teardown).
site_condition_rules.effect: ground_0_8ft=1.00, first_8_13ft=1.30, second_13_17ft=1.60, high_17_19ft=1.90, extreme_19plus=2.20. Applied as time multiplier: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier.
site_condition_rules.notes: Uses FAC_TRRP_HEIGHT — NOT FAC_EXT_ACCESS. Per-component, not per-project. Trim requires painter AT working height for brush work.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: All tasks on the affected component (prep and coating).
site_condition_rules.effect: simple_flat=1.00, standard_profiled=1.15, built_up=1.30, elaborate=1.60. Applied as time multiplier: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier.
site_condition_rules.notes: Per-component type. One building may have simple corner boards (1.0x) and elaborate window surrounds (1.60x).

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: Prep tasks only (scrape, sand, chalk remediation, dust cleanup, caulk). NOT coating tasks.
site_condition_rules.effect: GOOD=1.00, FAIR=1.50, POOR=2.00. Applied as time multiplier: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier.
site_condition_rules.notes: DSD is the dominant cost driver for repaint prep. Stacking pool: PREP_ONLY.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: Prep tasks involving paint disturbance (scrape, sand, power wash with paint removal).
site_condition_rules.notes: Pre-1978 + lead-positive triggers RRP. Doubles prep task duration. RRP containment setup/teardown are separate fixed tasks. Stacking pool: PREP_ONLY.

stacking_partition.description: Modifiers split into non-overlapping pools to prevent compound blowout. Prep and coating tasks share HEIGHT and COMPLEXITY but never share CONDITION/RRP with QT.

prep_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (FAC_TRRP_CONDITION x FAC_TRRP_RRP x FAC_TRRP_HEIGHT x FAC_TRRP_COMPLEXITY)
prep_tasks.max_stack_with_rrp: POOR (2.00) x RRP (2.00) x Extreme (2.20) x Elaborate (1.60) = 14.08x
prep_tasks.notes: FAC_TRRP_QT does NOT apply to prep tasks. Extreme stacks represent 19ft+ ornate trim with severe deterioration and lead paint — recommend T&M billing.

coating_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (FAC_TRRP_QT x FAC_TRRP_HEIGHT x FAC_TRRP_COMPLEXITY)
coating_tasks.notes: FAC_TRRP_CONDITION and FAC_TRRP_RRP do NOT apply to coating tasks. Once prepped, surface is at baseline.

fixed_tasks.notes: Assessment, equipment setup/cleanup, RRP containment setup/teardown are fixed-time tasks. No modifiers applied.

hard_stops.description: Soft, punky, or structurally compromised wood (rot). Cannot be painted. Requires replacement by carpenter/contractor before painting scope can proceed.
hard_stops.notes: Engine must prevent estimation when HARD_STOP is selected. Affected component is excluded — not entire project. Remaining components proceed normally. Legacy: SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE.

hard_stops.description: PVC trim with selected color LRV <55 without solar-reflective coating technology. Standard dark paint on PVC causes thermal distortion (warping, buckling, joint opening).
hard_stops.notes: Material gate — flagged during color approval. When PVC + LRV <55, system must select SYS_EXT_TRRP_FINISH_IR_REFLECTIVE instead of SYS_EXT_TRRP_FINISH_ACRYLIC.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Assess → Setup/Protect → Wash → Prep (state-dependent) → Caulk → Prime (state/material-dependent) → Interstage (QT4/QT5) → Finish 1 → Interstage (QT4/QT5) → Finish 2 → Final Inspect → Touch-up → Teardown → Cleanup
sequencing_notes.edge_work: No edge work across specs. Trim terminates at adjacent surfaces. Caulking at trim-to-siding junctions is this spec's responsibility.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Ground cover → Hardscape → Window/door masking → Light fixtures → Roofline edge → Siding masking (spray only) → RRP containment (if applicable)
sequencing_notes.elevation_strategy: Work one elevation at a time to minimize protection setup/teardown cycles. Process each trim component per elevation with its own height and complexity modifiers.
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO spray without full adjacent-surface masking. NO painting over DSD-4 (hard stop). NO RRP shortcuts. NO silicone caulk on PVC. NO skipping feather-edge sanding after scraping.

relationships.cross_spec_protection_note: Siding masking during trim spray work is THIS spec's responsibility. Window/door glass masking is THIS spec's responsibility when painting adjacent casings. Siding spec handles its own protection separately.
relationships.notes: Second repaint spec in the system after SF_SIDING_WOOD_EXT_RP. Introduces trim-specific height modifier (FAC_TRRP_HEIGHT), complexity modifier (FAC_TRRP_COMPLEXITY), 8 paintable items, substrate material dimension, and per-component modifier application.

maintenance_cycles.description: Expected repaint intervals for exterior trim by quality tier, assuming proper prep and application.

cycles.notes: Standard 2-coat repaint satin. Trim is more exposed to weathering than siding — slightly shorter cycle.
Premium 2-coat repaint semi-gloss with interstage sand. Longer cycle due to superior products and prep.
Superior 4-coat system gloss. Maximum film build. Longest maintenance cycle.

maintenance_cycles.routine_maintenance_definition: Annual inspection, caulk repair at trim joints, spot touch-up of minor damage. Adds ~5 years to repaint interval at all tiers.

sections_used: Referenced for context only — this spec uses FAC_TRRP_HEIGHT, not FAC_EXT_ACCESS
NOT used as estimation modifiers (RC-003 from PaintFactor OS)

research_corrections.original_claim: RRP modifier is 1.40x on prep tasks
research_corrections.corrected_to: RRP modifier is 2.00x on prep tasks involving paint disturbance. The 1.40x figure from research was a rough estimate; the production.json engineer calibrated to 2.00x based on actual wet-scraping, HEPA vacuum, and containment maintenance overhead per EPA RRP procedural requirements.

research_corrections.original_claim: Environmental conditions (wind, dew point, sun, surface temp) should be estimation modifiers
research_corrections.corrected_to: Environmental conditions are NOT estimatable — unpredictable at bid time. Excluded from spec entirely.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior trim repaint. SECOND REPAINT SPEC — introduces trim-specific height modifier (FAC_TRRP_HEIGHT with 5 tiers), complexity modifier (FAC_TRRP_COMPLEXITY with 4 levels), 8 paintable items (all LF), substrate material dimension (wood/PVC/engineered), per-component modifier application. Key features: combined assess+prep+prime+finish (single mobilization), 4 substrate states, 4 substrate conditions (DSD 0-3 + DSD-4 hard stop), 3 quality tiers (QT3-QT5, QT2 excluded for trim), 2 application methods (brush primary, spray conditional), 3 substrate materials, 44 tasks across 13 modules (39 binary + 5 qt_scaled), 6 material systems (4 primer + 2 finish), 5 factor modifiers (CONDITION/RRP/QT/HEIGHT/COMPLEXITY) with stacking partition, 8 round configurations, 8 protection zones (including RRP containment), 22 consumables (including 6 RRP-conditional), 18 compatibility rules, 14 variants, 22 PaintScope inputs (8 trim component LF keys + 6 protection + 5 config enums + 3 misc). Modifier stacking: prep max 12.32x with RRP (extreme conditions — recommend T&M), coating max 5.28x (QT5 + extreme height + elaborate). 2 hard stops (DSD-4 substrate damage, PVC LRV <55 gate).
